Projects

Syncable

AWSAngularNodeJSMongoDBDocker

A SaaS platform for event and studio management, enabling businesses and artists to create, manage, and promote events like classes, workshops, and shows. I led its development with integrated ticketing, ABAC for secure data separation, and a Dockerized CI/CD pipeline for rapid AWS deployments. The platform scaled to 200+ users, processing $12,000+ in transactions, with third-party integrations including SendGrid, Razorpay, NewRelic, and Logz.io.

Reddit Engine: Actor Model

GolangProtoActorSQLiteTailwind

Developed a high-performance, Reddit-like app in Golang using ProtoActor, supporting 500+ concurrent users and tens of thousands of interactions in 30 seconds. Built with a scalable actor-based architecture, leveraging Zipf's distribution for realistic engagement, SQLite for concurrency-safe operations, and seamless scalability to enterprise databases. A Main Actor managed 50+ entity actors, ensuring robust concurrency, efficient task routing, and fault tolerance, highlighting advanced actor-model system design.
